title: Film events for the sound builder (sound/tools/mixer/build_sound.py)

bpm.description: film tempo; override of the kit music map

t0_s.description: film time of a beat on the cut grid

cut_frames.description: scene cut frames; interior ones get a transition whoosh at cut-5 frames and are checked against the beat grid

intensity.description: 0.5 = rule gain; +-3 dB across the range for hit/ring layers

role.description: role final = the settle event: a bar downbeat of the bed is aligned to it

dur_s.description: span for layers marked span (risers, strokes, ambient)
